summary: Russia conducted one of its largest overnight attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, launching dozens of Shahed UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and Bandero cruise missiles across at least 10 oblasts. Strikes hit a Kharkiv hospital injuring 73, killed one in Dnipro with 17 wounded, and a drone killed a 14-year-old girl in Kyiv region. Ukrainian air defenses engaged widespread targets while ballistic missile threats from Bryansk region remain high.
key_points: Overnight Russian attack on energy infrastructure is one of the largest, further complicating the energy system. (Source: @UkraineNow/85098)
Russian strike on Kharkiv hospital injured 73 people, over 200 patients evacuated. (Source: @UkraineNow/85087)
Russian attack on Dnipro killed 1, injured at least 17, damaged hospice and residential buildings. (Source: @UkraineNow/85090)
Russian drone killed 14-year-old girl in Khotiv village, Kyiv region, hitting private house. (Source: @UkraineNow/85095)
Geran-5 missile struck Kovel substation, targeting energy infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77914)
Bandero cruise missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv and Rivne regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77921)
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77920)
Over 15 Shahed UAVs from Kharkiv region heading toward Poltava and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @kpszsu/92893)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of Shahed UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and Bandero cruise missiles across at least ten Ukrainian oblasts, targeting energy infrastructure and population centers. Critical hits included a Kharkiv hospital with 73 injured, a Dnipro strike killing one and wounding 17, and a drone killing a child in Kyiv region. Ukrainian air defenses engaged continuously while intelligence warns of imminent Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region.

points: Ukrainian air defense units engaged incoming threats across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Volyn oblasts throughout the night. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77917, @mon1tor_ua/77915, @mon1tor_ua/77919, @mon1tor_ua/77931)
Ukrenergo confirmed the energy system situation further deteriorated after the large-scale attacks on energy infrastructure overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/85098)
In Kharkiv, 73 people were injured when a Russian strike hit a hospital; over 200 patients were evacuated to other medical facilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85087)
Dnipro attack killed one civilian, injured at least 17 (three in critical condition), damaged a hospice and residential buildings; nearly 100 hospital patients relocated. (Source: @UkraineNow/85090)

SBU identified 100 participants in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka unrest, opened three criminal proceedings; claims of deaths called fakes; woman posing as medic attempted to remove a man from a military unit; action allegedly planned to create public resonance using a National Guardsman. (Source: @UkraineNow/85100)

President Zelensky at Berlin Security Conference warned European partners that Russia's military buildup in recent years is too extensive to be aimed only at Ukraine and is directed against them. (Source: @UkraineNow/85101)

Russian forces launched at least 12 Shahed UAVs from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region (Boryspil district), 6-10 from Sumy region toward Poltava (Lubny district), 6 from Chernihiv toward Kyiv (Boryspil), 3 toward Voznesensk (Mykolaiv), 3 from Cherkasy toward Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi district), 2 from Kyiv toward Cherkasy, 2 from Dnipropetrovsk toward Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia district), 2 reactive Shaheds from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv/Odesa border, 1 on Zaporizhzhia, 1 circling over Vasylkiv (Kyiv), 1 from Poltava toward Cherkasy (Zolotonosha district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77917)

Additional waves included 14 Shaheds on Kropyvnytskyi/Oleksandriia/Novoukrainska, 11 from Sumy to Poltava (Myrhorod district), 10 from Kharkiv to Poltava (Poltava district), 8 from Cherkasy to Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi district), 5 from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia district), 4 on Cherkasy, 3 on Odesa region, 1 from Kyiv to Cherkasy, 1 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Boryspil), 1 past Kyiv to Obukhiv/Kozyn, 1 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77919)

Geran-5 missiles fired from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv (Chernihiv district), from Chernihiv toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod district), from Vinnytsia toward Khmelnytskyi (Kamianets-Podilskyi district), and from Vinnytsia toward Khmelnytskyi (Khmelnytskyi district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77894, @mon1tor_ua/77915)

Bandero cruise missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod district) and Rivne region (Sarny, Berezne); one from Zhytomyr region toward Rivne. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77921, @mon1tor_ua/77923, @kpszsu/92894, @eRadarrua/128530)
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region reported by monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77920, @kpszsu/92884, @kpszsu/92860)

Reactive UAVs detected from Rivne region toward Volyn, from Poltava toward Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), from Vinnytsia toward Zhmerynka, from Black Sea toward Ochakiv (Mykolaiv) and Chornomorske/Pivdenne (Odesa), from Kharkiv region along Poltava/Donetsk border toward Kirovohrad. (Source: @kpszsu/92865, @kpszsu/92919, @kpszsu/92908, @kpszsu/92863, @kpszsu/92913, @eRadarrua/128529)

UAV groups from Kharkiv region moving along the administrative border of Poltava and Donetsk oblasts toward Kirovohrad region; at least 11 UAVs reported over Kirovohrad, 6 over Cherkasy. (Source: @eRadarrua/128529)
Two reactive UAVs circling on the border of Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77894)
Reactive Shahed from Kherson region targeted Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
Strike UAV groups reported in Dnipropetrovsk region (4 groups), Poltava region (3 groups), and Kirovohrad region (9 groups). (Source: @eRadarrua/128525)

Chernihiv region: multiple UAV groups (strike UAVs 3 groups, reactive 1 group) operating; specific locations include Nizhyn, Bakhmach, 4 near Pryluky, Vybli; Geran-5 launched from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv district. (Source: @eRadarrua/128546, @eRadarrua/128526, @mon1tor_ua/77894)
Sumy region: strike UAVs 4 groups; UAVs near Stepanivka; new UAVs entering from Kursk region (Russia). (Source: @eRadarrua/128518, @kpszsu/92916)

Kyiv region: air raid alert level increased at 23:06; Bandero cruise missile entered Vyshhorod district; Shaheds targeting Brovary, Kyiv (TEC-6/Lisovyi masyv), Obukhiv/Kozyn; reactive UAV from Chernihiv past Desna; Geran-5 from Chernihiv toward Vyshhorod district. (Source: @eRadarrua/128512, @mon1tor_ua/77921, @mon1tor_ua/77927, @mon1tor_ua/77932, @eRadarrua/128531, @mon1tor_ua/77894)
Zhytomyr region: Bandero cruise missile 1 unit; reactive UAV on Zviahel from east. (Source: @eRadarrua/128526, @kpszsu/92867)
Mykolaiv region: reactive UAVs from Black Sea toward Ochakiv; Shaheds on Voznesensk (3). (Source: @kpszsu/92863, @kpszsu/92917, @mon1tor_ua/77917)
Odesa region: reactive UAV from Black Sea toward Chornomorske/Pivdenne; Shaheds (3) reported. (Source: @kpszsu/92913, @mon1tor_ua/77919)
Kherson region: reactive Shahed launched toward Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
Zaporizhzhia region: reactive Shahed targeted; 2 reactive UAVs circling on Zaporizhzhia/Dnipropetrovsk border. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915, @mon1tor_ua/77894)
